notes: Official Top Juice website, FAQ, and CalorieKing Australia Top Juice entries were checked on 2026-07-07.

The official site confirms Top Juice sells protein shakes and lists ingredients for examples such as Protein Shake 1 with coconut water, blueberry, and whey protein, plus Big Hit Shake with fresh coconut water, espresso, hazelnut, and whey protein.
The official FAQ says dairy alternatives and vegan protein substitutions are available, but it does not publish item-level calories or protein grams.
CalorieKing Australia publishes item-level Top Juice calories, kJ, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sugar, and sodium for Protein Shake 1 through Protein Shake 6.

Import confidence should be high-confidence estimate rather than exact because the macro values are from CalorieKing, while current official Top Juice pages confirm menu existence and ingredients but not numeric macros.

Do not assume vegan status for the default shakes because the official examples use whey protein. They are vegetarian by default, with vegan substitution availability requiring custom-order handling that should not be imported without separate macros.
